verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs say it checks availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs, which covers the breadth half of the story. Its registration flow also runs a pre-flight eligibility check, a small hint that restricted TLDs are handled. Nothing in the pack shows per-TLD documentation of special requirements such as ccTLD residency or restricted-TLD rules. missing for 10: per-TLD documentation of registration requirements, explicit coverage of restricted TLDs and country codes, a published TLD list or count, independent corroboration of TLD breadth

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: Check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs (no auth required)
Pass dryRun: true to run every pre-flight check (availability, price match, eligibility, funds, spend limit) without charging or creating anything
